newsitem.title: USA: Starrett to merge with Jacob Frydman entity.
newsitem.headline: Starrett to merge with Jacob Frydman entity.

text.p: Starrett Corp said Thursday it agreed to be acquired by an entity controlled by Jacob Frydman for $12.25 per share in cash.
Based on Starrett's 6.2 million shares outstanding in the first quarter, the deal is worth a total of about $75 million.
Jacob Frydman is president of Frydman & Co, a real estate merchant bank that develops property in Manhattan and the surrounding area. Starrett Corp builds and sells residential and office properties.

Starrett said holders of about 52 percent of its outstanding shares have agreed to vote their shares in favor of the merger. Those shareholders are Paul Milstein, Seymour Milstein, Henry Benach, Oded Aboodi and Irving Fisher.
The company said it expects the merger will be submitted to its shareholders for a vote within the next 90 days.
